description: Internal and external works including: full redecoration; replacement kitchen units and rearrangement; new lighting and full electrical rewiring with new consumer unit; replacement radiators and heated towel rails; new sanitaryware in first floor and second floor bathrooms including new vanity unit with Carrara marble top; bespoke joinery including bookshelves, wardrobes and jib doors to bedrooms and hallway; reduction of doorway to sitting room with new door; new fireplace surround to master bedroom; sanding and refinishing of timber floors; new floor tiles to kitchen and bathrooms; new carpet to stairwell and landings; installation of washer/dryer to second floor landing cupboard. External works including rehanging of kitchen stable door to open outwards; installation of secondary glazing; replacement of second floor dormer window to match original design; repointing of brickwork; repainting/varnishing of front door.
